title: Studio shows machine names where labels exist: Explain access principal chips and result banner, and the list-view Columns chips
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Reach: two Studio surfaces, each reproduced 2/2.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui Studio lane seat. Render each chip below through its metadata label, falling back to the name only when no label exists. Both surfaces fall under the same checklist clause, so they are folded into one card.

## What

Two Studio surfaces show machine names where labels exist.

**(a) Explain access.**
- Path: Studio → any package → Access → **Explain access**, with User = a member and Object = any, then Explain.
- The Principal card's "Positions:" and "Permission sets:" chips show `org_member`, `showcase_member_default`…, and the result banner reads `Read on "uxscratch_widget"`.
- Labels exist: `GET /api/v1/meta/position/org_member` → "Organization Member".
- `POST /api/v1/security/explain` returns names only in `principal.positions` / `permissionSets`, so the client must resolve the labels.

**(b) List-view Columns chips.**
- In a scratch package: Studio → Interfaces → create an app with "Add this package's objects as menu items", then select the object's nav item.
- Properties → LIST VIEW → **Columns** chips read the field names (`title`, `owner_ref`). The labels are "Widget Name" and "Owner Ref". No `title` attribute is set.

Measured on objectstack `main` `2034975a` with console pin `daeb77fc`. This is outside the closed objectui#11862.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included → 5 hits, none matching (by the cloud runner).

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · clause 0
